name: Melano
source:
Melano is the mysterious leader of the small party that planned and exectued the assault on Rughzenhaide. She is an enigma to most, even her own subordinates, whom all respect and revere her, but simultaneously fear her.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/fault-milestone-one-directors-cut/description?lang=es]Fault's Kickstarter[/url]]
